focus_en: Learn your opener cold and practice tone and body language in short bursts. No full days of real knocking yet.
focus_es: Aprende tu presentación de memoria y practica el tono y el lenguaje corporal en sesiones cortas. Todavía no toques puertas todo el día.
daily_goal: Do 3 short (10-min) Practice Door roleplays and say your opener out loud from memory once.

focus_en: Start knocking real doors at low volume so the habit sticks without burning out; log every door in the app.
focus_es: Empieza a tocar puertas reales en poco volumen para que se vuelva costumbre sin agotarte; registra cada puerta en la app.
daily_goal: Knock 10 real doors (about 1 hour), log each one, and do 1 practice roleplay before you go out.

focus_en: Build door volume toward a full route and always ask for one small next step.
focus_es: Aumenta las puertas hacia una ruta completa y pide siempre un solo paso pequeño.
daily_goal: Knock 20-25 doors and end every conversation with one clear next step (a time, or a free look), not 'I'll call you.'

focus_en: Hit full daily volume and work toward your first booked inspection.
focus_es: Alcanza el volumen completo y trabaja para tu primera inspección agendada.
daily_goal: Knock 25-35 doors (a full route) and show photos before any paperwork when someone is ready.

focus_en: Lock in the legally required lines: the 3-day cancel right and honest deductible answers, every single time.
focus_es: Fija las líneas obligatorias por ley: el derecho de cancelar en 3 días y respuestas honestas sobre el deducible, siempre.
daily_goal: In every roleplay and real paperwork talk, say the 3-day cancel right out loud (EN and ES) and answer deductible questions honestly.

focus_en: Keep full volume and start following up on older doors and leads, not just new ones.
focus_es: Mantén el volumen completo y empieza a dar seguimiento a puertas y clientes anteriores, no solo a los nuevos.
daily_goal: Knock your full route, plus 3-5 follow-ups from the last 2 weeks (door revisits, or calls/texts only to homeowners who gave you their number and asked); keep your streak alive.

focus_en: Work full days on your own, review your numbers weekly against the benchmarks, and adjust what isn't working.
focus_es: Trabaja días completos por tu cuenta, revisa tus números cada semana contra los puntos de referencia y ajusta lo que no funcione.
daily_goal: Beat your best doors-to-booked-inspections this block, and write one line about what worked.
